question.problem:
$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}^{′}(t)=3{x}_{1}(t)-{x}_{2}(t) \\ {x}_{2}^{′}(t)=2{x}_{2}(t)+5,\end{aligned}\,x(0)=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the initial value problem above. By applying the Laplace transform $L$ to both sides of each equation in our system, we get a system with variables ${X}_{1}(s)=L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}$ and ${X}_{2}(s)=L\{{x}_{2}(t)\}.$ In terms of the parameter $s,$ the solution of the new system is

${X}_{1}(s)=$ {{field-1}} $,\,$
${X}_{2}(s)=\frac{s+5}{s(s-2)}.$
question.worked_solution:
First, we compute the Laplace transforms of both sides of each equation in our system:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}L\{{x}_{1}^{′}(t)\}=L\{3{x}_{1}(t)-{x}_{2}(t)\} \\ L\{{x}_{2}^{′}(t)\}=L\{2{x}_{2}(t)+5\}\end{aligned}\,\,
$$

Using the derivative property of the Laplace transform, we obtain the system

$$
\{\begin{aligned}sL\{{x}_{1}(t)\}-{x}_{1}(0)=3L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}-L\{{x}_{2}(t)\} \\ sL\{{x}_{2}(t)\}-{x}_{2}(0)=2L\{{x}_{2}(t)\}+5L\{1\}\end{aligned}
$$

which can be simplified to the following:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}s{X}_{1}(s)-2=3{X}_{1}(s)-{X}_{2}(s) \\ s{X}_{2}(s)-1=2{X}_{2}(s)+\frac{5}{s}\end{aligned}
$$

where ${X}_{1}(s)=L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}$ and ${X}_{2}(s)=L\{{x}_{2}(t)\},$ and we have used the fact that $L\{1\}=\frac{1}{s}.$

Now, solving the second equation for ${X}_{2}(s),$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}s{X}_{2}(s)-1 & =2{X}_{2}(s)+\frac{5}{s} \\ (s-2){X}_{2}(s) & =1+\frac{5}{s} \\ (s-2){X}_{2}(s) & =\frac{s+5}{s} \\ {X}_{2}(s) & =\frac{s+5}{s(s-2)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting this in the first equation and solving for ${X}_{1}(s)$, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}s{X}_{1}(s)-2 & =3{X}_{1}(s)-{X}_{2}(s) \\ (s-3){X}_{1}(s) & =2-{X}_{2}(s) \\ (s-3){X}_{1}(s) & =2-(\frac{s+5}{s(s-2)}) \\ (s-3){X}_{1}(s) & =\frac{2s(s-2)-(s+5)}{s(s-2)} \\ (s-3){X}_{1}(s) & =\frac{2({s}^{2}-2s)-s-5}{s(s-2)} \\ (s-3){X}_{1}(s) & =\frac{2{s}^{2}-4s-s-5}{s(s-2)} \\ (s-3){X}_{1}(s) & =\frac{2{s}^{2}-5s-5}{s(s-2)} \\ {X}_{1}(s) & =\frac{2{s}^{2}-5s-5}{s(s-2)(s-3)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution of the new system in terms of parameter $s$ is 

$$
{X}_{1}(s)=\frac{2{s}^{2}-5s-5}{s(s-2)(s-3)},\,{X}_{2}(s)=\frac{s+5}{s(s-2)}.
$$
